verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships a built-in 'AI Helpbot' assistant (cmd/ctrl+K) that users can invoke inside the product, but docs describe it as answering questions from approved support content rather than executing tasks on the user's behalf; other AI features (First Pass AI evidence pre-screening, GenAI DDQ autofill) are automations rather than a conversational assistant you delegate work to. Missing for 10: evidence the Helpbot can actually perform/execute actions (not just answer questions), and independent/hands-on confirmation of task delegation capability.
